test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ed0487fe035037d868cf1868b78dbdc2c8c363f7467eef81b0d0f39b91f950c.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical sequence pattern:

Option 1: XY – ZA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2726df465a99f0b7edc0582549b2bf29e905261fcf708cf6198eb3862694693b.png] 

Option 2: QR – ST

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bacb229fa30b5811601818421b51abb4722ab7a2577c9483d00e45dc71ea9d6.png] 

Option 3: NO – PQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bf48372f05c898de17b8e8cd3ebb5cd1fa5ffff440e3d874592d3bcb67bea39.png] 

Option 4: LM – MQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca626bc0eda12a1d6915a714c709bb0f20ff9ea7c1acf9c74b834d49a958f5fc.png] 

Thus, LM – MQ does not follow the continuous alphabetical sequence pattern.

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 4.**
